name: Supertonic 3 voice
why: Reads videos aloud on your Mac, offline and free.

darwin.check: test -x "$HOME/.careeros/venv/bin/python" && "$HOME/.careeros/venv/bin/python" -c 'import sys, importlib.metadata as m; sys.exit(m.version("supertonic") != "1.3.1")'
install: py="$(for p in python3 python3.14 python3.13 python3.12 python3.11; do b="$(command -v $p)" || continue; [ "$b" = /usr/bin/python3 ] && continue; "$b" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(0 if (3, 11) <= sys.version_info[:2] <= (3, 14) else 1)' && echo "$b" && break; done)" && test -n "$py" && "$py" -m venv "$HOME/.careeros/venv"

win32.check: if (-not (Test-Path "$HOME/.careeros/venv/Scripts/python.exe")) { exit 1 }; & "$HOME/.careeros/venv/Scripts/python.exe" -c 'import sys, importlib.metadata as m; sys.exit(m.version(''supertonic'') != ''1.3.1'')'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }
install: if ((Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { foreach ($v in '3.14', '3.13', '3.12', '3.11') { py "-$v" -c 'import sys' 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { py "-$v" -m venv "$HOME/.careeros/venv"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; exit 0 } } }; foreach ($p in 'python', 'python3') { if ((Get-Command $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { & $p -c 'import sys; sys.exit(0 if (3, 11) <= sys.version_info[:2] <= (3, 14) else 1)' 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & $p -m venv "$HOME/.careeros/venv"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; exit 0 } } }; exit 1
& "$HOME/.careeros/venv/Scripts/python.exe" -c 'from supertonic import TTS; TTS(auto_download=True)'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }
